youtubeTitle: GTA VI Hands-On Gameplay Impressions: Cinematic Quality and 30FPS Cap
socialHook: RockstarINTEL shares first hands‑on impressions of GTA VI, highlighting cinematic quality and a 30FPS performance cap.

sections.heading: First Impressions
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL’s first hands‑on impressions of GTA VI describe a cinematic experience that rivals Red Dead Redemption 2, with top‑tier acting, fluid animations, and an immersive open world called Leonida that feels truly lived‑in.

The report notes that Rockstar has dramatically increased unique and realistic NPC interactions, offering far more depth than previous titles, and praises the game’s overall polish, especially the improved collision system that reduces clipping incidents to rare occurrences.

sections.heading: Technical Performance
paragraphs: Rockstar reworked the default control scheme to borrow from Red Dead 2’s interaction system and modernizes even basic inputs, which may require an adjustment period for long‑time GTA players but ultimately provides greater versatility.

The article also addresses the controversy over a locked 30FPS frame rate, explaining that Rockstar prioritized immersive gameplay and visual fidelity over a higher frame rate, resulting in a stable but not silky smooth performance.
